lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Tell me, small fry

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: what on earth is going on here at the Outpost?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Why do these pathetic Nikkes

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: lack so much discipline?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: A stiff wind could blow them over,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: yet rather than training, they stand and joke amongst themselves

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: or cause a ruckus by lighting off fireworks.
Seems like you met the Carronades.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: They're not the only problem.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: This entire place is practically festering with indolence.
The Outpost has always been that way.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Always?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Yes, the Outpost may be a lightning rod

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: for slugs like yourselves,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: but isn't it still a military base?
Being on edge 24/7 isn't necessarily a good thing.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Tsk

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Here I was, wondering

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: how come the Nikkes here are about as useful as a can opener.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Turns out their so-called Commander is the laziest of them all.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Pull yourself together,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: weakling.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Do you even realize what it means

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: to have the surface right in your backyard?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You'll never know when and how you may be under attack,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: yet here you are spewing nonsense about how

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: it's unnecessary to stay on your toes.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: This is a dereliction of duty!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It's so pathetic that I can't watch.
Are you worried about us?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: (Inappropriate language detected. Unable to send SMS.)

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Weakling,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: just when I thought you couldn't barf out any more nonsensical drivel.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Your idiocy never ceases to amaze me.
I'll be more alert so that we're prepared for any surprise attacks.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: (Inappropriate language detected. Unable to send SMS.)

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I shouldn't have expected anything from you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: And you call yourself a commander...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Bah!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Do whatever you want!
Thank you for caring.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What are you going on about?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Shut up

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't talk to me.
There are no further messages from Eunhwa.
